about: Ben Denckla's readings of the Koren edition at the candidates listed in doc/meteg-after-silluq-koren-lookup-candidates.md, one per reference, in the order he reported them. 'koren' says which of the two U+05BD on MAM's final atom Koren has: 'first' (the first mark only), 'last' (the last mark only) or 'both'. 'date' is the day Ben reported the reading. The primary clone's .novc/mas_c_write_doc.py fills that file's Koren column from this list.
